params.prompt:
Run skill in {skill_path} for the following assets: {assets}.

Market close date: {market_close_date}.

Generate the actual report exactly as defined by the skill instructions, including the output format and output path specified by the skill.

After the skill has produced its report, write a completion signal JSON file to {completion_signal_path} with at least: {{"status":"completed","assets":{assets_json},"market_close_date":"{market_close_date}"}}.
